sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import json
records=[json.loads(s) for s in open('/var/log/kubernetes/audit.log')]
probe=[d for d in records if d.get('objectRef',{}).get('name')=='audit-probe']
for d in probe:print(json.dumps({k:d.get(k) for k in ['auditID','level','verb','objectRef','responseStatus']}))
tokens=[d for d in records if d.get('objectRef',{}).get('subresource')=='token']
print('token_events',len(tokens),'response_bodies',sum('responseObject' in d for d in tokens))
assert tokens and all(d['level']=='Metadata' and 'responseObject' not in d for d in tokens)
assert any(d.get('objectRef',{}).get('resource')=='rolebindings' and d['level']=='RequestResponse' for d in probe)
PY
